verdict.rationale: Databricks provides Auto Loader and Structured Streaming to incrementally and continuously ingest new files/events as they arrive in cloud storage without managing custom pipeline infrastructure, plus Lakeflow pipelines for managed orchestration and a connector catalog for standard sources. This is documented as a core, serverless/managed capability rather than a DIY framework. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of 'no infrastructure management' claims at scale, and more detail on exactly-once guarantees under failure scenarios beyond docs.
